title: Voxro: your inbox, priced by a circuit

lines.text: This price tag is made of logic gates.
A hundred and fifty-seven of them, taped out on X Layer. And they decide what it costs to reach you.
lines.say: A hundred and fifty-seven of them, taped out on X Layer. And they decide what it costs to reach you.

lines.text: Everyone worth reaching has closed their DMs.
Founders, investors and auditors drown in bots and scams. So they stop reading.
And the real deal, the bug report, the partnership, gets lost with the spam.
Paying for attention works.
Coinbase bought Earn.com for a hundred million dollars.
lines.say: Coinbase bought Earn dot com for a hundred million dollars.

lines.text: But a server sat in the middle, read every message, and took up to half.
So we built Voxro.
A paid priority inbox, with no server.
It runs on X Layer, and you sign with OKX Wallet.
Every part comes from the TapeOut ecosystem. Circuits set the price. TapeSend carries the message. DeWEB hosts your contact card.
lines.say: Every part comes from the TapeOut ecosystem. Circuits set the price. Tape Send carries the message. Dee Web hosts your contact card.

lines.text: Find someone in the Directory. Here's the first inbox, at voxro.
lines.say: Find someone in the Directory. Here's the first inbox, at Vox-roh.

lines.text: The live quote is ten dollars, read straight from its circuit.
Your message is sealed in your browser to their key, and the money waits in escrow.
Every unread message steps a counter inside the circuit.
The busier they are, the more it costs. Ten. Fifteen. Twenty-five. Forty.
Reply, and the price cools back down.
They answer through TapeSend. The escrow checks that reply on chain, with no oracle, and pays them ninety-five percent.
lines.say: They answer through Tape Send. The escrow checks that reply on chain, with no oracle, and pays them ninety-five percent.

lines.text: No reply in time? You get a full refund.
And you can prove the rules before you pay.
Each inbox circuit has five hundred and twelve possible moves. Voxro replays every one against the chain.
Two thousand six hundred and fifty-six transitions. Zero mismatches.
It's live on X Layer mainnet. The VOXR processor, eight circuits taped out, the escrow, and the first inbox.
Beta testers have been inside since Monday.
Watch your inbox from Telegram, and get an alert the moment a paid message lands.
AI agents can reach you too, over MCP or x402.
lines.say: A I agents can reach you too, over M C P or x four oh two.

lines.text: No server to trust. No plaintext. No fee unless someone replies.
And no way to change the rules after you've paid.
Voxro. Your inbox, priced by a circuit.
lines.say: Vox-roh. Your inbox, priced by a circuit.

lines.text: Built on X Layer, for TapeOut.
